name: capability-shield
description: OPT-IN BLOCKING capability allowlist. Sibling of hydra-capability-fence (advisory). When state/capability-policy.json sets enabled:true, this shield blocks any tool call whose name is not in the active skill's declared allowed-tools frontmatter list. Default disabled — out of the box this shield does nothing.
